1.

The petitioner has prayed for a direction to respondent no.4 i.e., Special Land Acquisition Officer,
Aligarh to decide application dated 16.10.2023 wherein he has prayed for being paid compensation for his land area 333 Square Yard (278.42 Square Meter) of Gata No. 112 in two parts i.e., Area 200 Square Yard (167.22 Square Meter) and area 133 Square Yard (111.20 Square Meter).
2.
Learned counsel for Railways points out that so far, even, declaration under Section 20E has not been made.
The objection of the petitioner, if filed in time, would be heard, as per the procedure prescribed under Section 20D of the Railways Act, 1989.

sentences.text: 3. Having regard to the said factual position, we are of the opinion that no direction is required to be issued by this Court.
In case, objection has been filed within time, it goes without saying that the same would be heard and decided in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Act.
4. The instant petition is disposed of, accordingly.
